subject.title: [Feature]: Intelligent Model Fallback with Wildcard/Auto Selection

question: Which public provider-family fallback contract should OpenClaw support for text agent failover: wildcard/auto model refs, grouped fallbackFamilies, catalog-derived fallbacks, or no new fallback surface?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but each option creates different public config semantics and provider-routing behavior that automation should not choose for maintainers.

options.title: Design one canonical fallback contract
options.body: Adopt one family-aware contract and land it consistently across schema, normalization, runtime fallback construction, availability gates, docs, and tests.

options.title: Narrow to catalog-derived fallbacks
options.body: Use the fallbacksFromModels direction from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/60922 and leave wildcard/auto plus fallbackFamilies out of scope for now.

options.title: Keep explicit fallbacks only
options.body: Document explicit fallbacks and auth.order as the supported path, then close this feature request as not planned.

recommendation.title: Design one canonical fallback contract
recommendation.body: Adopt one family-aware contract and land it consistently across schema, normalization, runtime fallback construction, availability gates, docs, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is repeated work on the exact model fallback, config schema, OpenAI/Codex routing, and failover docs surface.
